name: metalogics-chatbot-monorepo
description: Metalogics AI Assistant - Monorepo with Backend, Frontend, and Widget

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix widget
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix widget
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules widget/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist widget/dist

author: Metalogics
